dict.string: bycoda uses the microphone when you start dictation, a microphone test, or a voice conversation.
bycoda captures the screen area you choose when you take a screenshot in the quick composer, and desktop control reads the screen when you allow it.
bycoda opens project folders you choose, including Desktop.
bycoda opens project folders you choose, including Documents.
bycoda opens project folders you choose, including Downloads.
bycoda opens project folders you choose, including folders on removable drives.
bycoda opens project folders you choose, including folders on network volumes.
bycoda connects to devices and development servers on your local network.
Commands that you or an agent run in a bycoda terminal may ask to control other apps, for example through AppleScript.
Tools that you or an agent run in a bycoda terminal may ask to use the camera.
